title: Hieronymus Łaski's cipher (System B): four letters to the Bavarian court, 1529-1531, BayHStA Kurbayern Äußeres Archiv 4591 (DECODE R9322, R9323, R9417, R9403; catalogues 161 and 162)

steps.what: DECODE record list of KAA 4591 from the API dump; images of R9322, R9323, R9417 fetched with the cookie (with the other catalogue-161 records)
Łaski cipher key rebuilt from 153 glossed word pairs on R9322/R9417; unglossed lines decoded
DECODE images of R9403, R9414, R9415 and neighbours R9404-R9407, R9418-R9422 fetched with the cookie
R9403 read with Łaski's System B key from targets/kaa4591/sysB (now targets/kaa4591b/sysB)
R9403: e and r swapped (⋇ = e, X = r), variant sign shapes; DAG word sign = King John
R9403 read line by line, 414/416 words
Web search for KAA 4591 and its ciphers (no edition found)
Web search for Łaski 1531, Zápolya letters to the Bavarian dukes, Augurelio, Acta Tomiciana

Split under the one-key rule (George Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): the four letters in Łaski's System B (R9322, R9323, R9417 from kaa4591; R9403 from kaa4591b) gathered into this entry; R9414 (system G) moved to wardein1537 and R9415 (system L) to sperantio1534, whose key it shares. Words re-counted per letter (measure_sysb.py; R9403 r9403/decoded.txt).

Statistical validation (docs/_validate.py): 862 tokens, 21 types, la order 4: reading -2.091 per letter; random keys -6.002 (z 7.4); key annealed onto shuffled ciphertext best -3.682 (mean -3.757, z 37.1); annealer on the real text -2.091. Verdict: pass.

Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): sign files and page tsv per letter, sysB/decoded.txt, sysB/R9323_decoded.txt, r9403/decoded.txt; key sysB/key_from_glosses.tsv.

validation.notes: claimed per-occurrence score -2.002; polyphony 0.049; 3476 unread tokens left out; annealer on the real text from random keys reached -2.091

outcome.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext
outcome.method_basis: The key was rebuilt from 153 word pairs of the contemporary interlinear glosses on R9322 and R9417 and decodes their unglossed lines; it then read R9323 and, with e and r exchanged, R9403.
outcome.fraction_read_source: words: measure_sysb.py over sysB/decoded.txt and sysB/R9323_decoded.txt (R9322 429/445, R9417 217/219, R9323 124/163; machine decodes, letter slips inside recognisable words counted as read) plus r9403/decoded.txt 414/416: 1184/1243
outcome.notes: R9322 (96.4%), R9417 (99.1%) and R9403 (99.5%) pass the read bar; R9323 (76.1%) does not: faint signs on lines 4 and 8-10. FLW (probably the king's title) is not settled.

texts.label: R9322, ff. 121-122, Buda 24 Nov 1529
texts.summary: f. 121: Hieronymus Łaski to a Bavarian duke, Buda 24 Nov 1529: the Sultan, forced home by plague in his army, left King John the kingdom of Hungary without tribute, with fifty guns and powder, and will return next summer against Ferdinand's lands unless there is a concord. f. 122: King John of Hungary to Duke Ludwig of Bavaria, sending Lazarus the Jew as envoy.

texts.label: R9417, f. 264, Kraków 16 June [1530]
texts.summary: Łaski to the dukes' secretary Waisenfelder, Kraków 16 June [1530]: the siege army before Buda; a concord best made through the imperial princes; an envoy sent to the King of France; the Sultan willing to receive in friendship whom King John names; envoys asked to meet at Coburg in July.

texts.label: R9323, f. 123, [1529-30]
texts.summary: Latin note to the Bavarian secretary from Łaski's circle: King John loves the Duke of Bavaria; Łaski wants concord between King John and Ferdinand, for without it the Turk will consume Bohemia and Austria. Several lines are faint.

texts.label: R9403, ff. 226-228, Łask 17 Sept 1531
texts.summary: Łaski to a councillor of the Bavarian dukes, 17 Sept 1531: the Sultan told Ferdinand's envoys there would be no peace or truce unless Hungary is given up to King John, and is preparing ships, guns and grain on the Danube; Łaski will ride to the Speyer diet and asks the dukes to stop any decision against the king; the royal marriage will be settled with the King of Poland.

prior.where: Contemporary interlinear glosses over parts of R9322, R9323 and R9417 (and the first lines of R9403); no edition found (web searches 21 and 22 Sept 2026).
